summary: Phase 35/39 — Claros Launch (Placement & Career Intelligence) E2E test. 15/15 backend tests pass; all 5 frontend pages render with full Claude AI flows (skill-gap + mock-interview eval) working end-to-end. Canonical alias /api/v1/claros-launch/* mirrors /api/v1/launch/* identically. RBAC enforced on /stats (student=403, admin/faculty=200). Two SIGNIFICANT spec gaps vs. review request: (1) ClarosLaunchAdmin page is read-only analytics only — NO create-drive form, companies table, drives table or add buttons exist; (2) Backend has NO POST /companies or POST /drives endpoints — only GET — so the prescribed admin write-flow and the RBAC POST-403 cases cannot exist as written.

minor.issue: Endpoint does not exist; review request expects admin write-flow + RBAC 403 for students. Currently only GET /drives is implemented. Cannot validate POST RBAC.
Endpoint does not exist; same gap as drives. Returns 405 Method Not Allowed for any caller.

Spec mismatch: review describes body={question_text, answer_text}; actual Pydantic model requires {question, answer, role, company_name?, company_id?}. Frontend code uses the actual schema, so functionality works — but the review-spec wording is wrong (or backend payload contract is undocumented).

ui_bugs.issue: Admin page does NOT contain create-drive form, companies/drives/recruiters tables, or add buttons described in the review request. It is purely read-only KPI + top-recruiters bar chart. Admin write-flow described in the task literally does not exist in code.

Breakdown cards display labels 'CGPA 26.2' and 'Mock Interview 15.3' — these are score contributions (out of 30 and 25) not raw values; the student's real CGPA is ~8.7 and mock-avg ~6/10. Labels read like raw metrics and are misleading. Recommend appending '/30' or renaming to 'CGPA score' / 'Mock score'.

issues: Still reads 'CLAROS LAUNCH · ADMIN ANALYTICS' — task says VCE tenant should rebrand display to 'PATHFINDER'. Tenant-config rebrand may not be wired into PageHeader for Launch pages (verify on other pages too).

action_items: Decide whether to (a) implement admin-write endpoints POST /api/v1/launch/companies + POST /api/v1/launch/drives and an admin-form UI on ClarosLaunchAdmin, OR (b) update the spec/review request to acknowledge admin Launch is read-only.

If admin write-flow is in scope: add Pydantic models for CompanyCreate / DriveCreate, role-gated routes (WRITE_ROLES), and UI forms with data-testids on the admin page. Tenants/seeds already populate drives via seed_claros_launch.py.
Fix Launch dashboard breakdown card labels: append units (e.g., 'CGPA / 30') or rename to 'CGPA score' to remove ambiguity with raw CGPA value.
Wire tenant rebrand ('PATHFINDER' for VCE) into Launch pages' PageHeader eyebrow / breadcrumb if the rebrand is intended to be visible there.
Either update the review-request body shape for POST /interview/evaluate to {question, answer, role, ...} or accept current shape (frontend already aligned).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_launch.py:71 — list_companies returns full company docs including prep_tips/skills_required to all roles; consider trimming for students or paginating beyond limit(200).

routes_launch.py:227 — skill_gaps prompt only samples 5 companies (limit 5) before union — small tenants with fewer companies may pass empty company_skills, causing trivial gaps. Acceptable but worth noting.

routes_launch.py:309 — evaluate_answer always persists a mock_interviews record even on parse failure of LLM JSON; if Claude rate-limits, fallback writes a row with score~3. Consider tagging records with provenance ('LLM'|'FALLBACK').

ClarosLaunchDashboard breakdown labels — see ui_bug, value semantics ambiguous.

rca of the issue: Phase 35 implementation shipped read-only admin analytics + student-facing flows. The review request assumed an admin write-flow was implemented (forms + POST routes), which was never built — this was likely a miscommunication carried into the review brief rather than a regression. Backend logic itself is sound: deterministic UUID seeding (idempotent), Claude JSON parsing with code-fence stripping, and fallback heuristics work cleanly. Canonical URL middleware rewrite is path-only and preserves auth/body — verified equality of /launch vs /claros-launch responses.
